finding: The v1 plan assigned batches separately for every target. Complete-gallery PDS would therefore compare target rows constructed from different batch halves, so the gallery was not coherent.

correction.partition: One donor-wide whole-batch partition is shared by every target for each split.
correction.search: For each frozen split seed, choose among 512 deterministic metadata-only candidate partitions by supported-target count and target-level UMI balance.
correction.target_level_null_gate: Reliability ranks are zero unless observed target reliability exceeds its own matched-null p95.
correction.batch_axis_validation: Raw scans must reproduce the exact ordered batch-label tuple frozen by plan v2.

orion_batch_semantics.local_file_unit: one numbered Batch*.parquet per GEM batch
